notes.title: DEATH FRONT JUST REACHED 1000 WISHLISTS 🔥(DevBlog #2)
notes.content:
Hey Mystery Hunters!

We’re back with another update from the Death Front team! But first, we wanted to thank you for helping us reach 1000 WISHLISTS! Your support on social media, Steam and Reddit means a lot to us. Thanks for all the wishlists and feedback!! We are really looking forward to continue hearing your thoughts on Discord to make Death Front the game you are waiting for! 

Now, let’s show some updates! Here’s what we’ve been working on lately:

[h3][b]Interaction/Inventory System[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758609/f16ba38f2d27de92de070c6763a6247a1fff843a.png[/img]

[b]More Interactions:[/b] You can now mess around with more items like videotapes, keys, TV sets, and radios. Everything is networked, so it works great in multiplayer too.

[b]Better Menus: [/b]We’ve improved the inventory and pause menu screens to make them easier to use.

[b]UI Updates:[/b] We’ve added more UI screens to the game, making everything look nicer and easier to navigate.

[h3][b]Player Improvements[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758609/c9a15d54eb801193ce6b39b21e4e4a641d4099ce.png[/img]

[b]Body Cam Effect:[/b] We’ve made the “body cam” effect look even cooler and more realistic.

[b]New Weapons:[/b] We’ve added the first versions of pistols, SMGs, and shotguns. Now you have more options besides the basic assault rifle.

[b]More Grenades:[/b] We’ve added more types of grenades and made them work better.

[b]New Abilities:[/b] Each player now has more exciting abilities to use.

[h3][b]Environment Updates[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758609/1d3e62fc99c8520171b2347c1bec0ff8eba7fd2d.png[/img]

[b]Level 1 Upgrades:[/b] We’re still working on making the first level look and feel amazing.

[b]Lighting and VFX:[/b] We’ve improved the lighting and added some cool visual effects to make everything look better.

[b]Materials and Textures:[/b] We’ve upgraded materials and textures for better performance and visuals.

We can’t wait for you to share your thoughts with us on social media and [url=https://discord.gg/t9kghUTdgP]Discord[/url] – we love hearing from you!

Thanks again for being awesome supporters! Stay tuned for more updates!

Catch you later!

The Death Front Team

notes.title: An Update from the Death Front Team!
notes.content:
Hello there Mystery Hunters! 

First of all, we wanted to start this Dev Blog by thanking all of you for all your comments and support across the different Social Media platforms and for hanging out with us on Discord to share your thoughts about our game. We also really appreciate all the wishlists from you, they make a huge difference!

We are loving this development journey and we are excited to be sharing some insights of what we are cooking behind the scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758609/600bd677b68457fc73f7138045b03ac39943ec8a.png[/img]

Today, we want to share with you that the development of the first level is one step closer to its completion. We are applying the final touches, meticulously placing props and optimising the performance. 

The time to encounter Jennifer is approaching and, if you stay tuned to our different [url=https://linktr.ee/deathfront]Socials[/url], you might get to know a bit more about her background story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758609/b7876c4bce14bb9f94ee4e7f1a12fa60627a673d.png[/img]

But that’s not all! 

We are happy to announce that we've officially kicked off the design process for level 2. Our team has created detailed and exciting lore behind it, and we are moving forward with fleshing it out. 

As we can’t share many more details on this level yet, we are also providing you a list of updates and improvements we have recently added to the game: 

1. Interaction/Inventory System: The first iteration of our interaction/inventory system has been implemented in the game.


2. AI improvements: Our developers are constantly testing and fine-tuning the intelligence of in-game entities to provide you with a more immersive and challenging experience.

3. UI implementation: The team is moving forward with implementing all the necessary UI for our game, focusing at the moment on the essential in-game screens and menus.


4. Animations: We are using motion-capture techniques to create exciting custom animations for our in-game characters. A new set of animations is about to be added to our existing set.


5. Audio Updates: We are also making strides in audio enhancement. Working on immersive soundscapes and dynamic effects to greatly enhance the audio experience, using FMOD and audio-specific blueprints. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758609/098a62e4a092d47a90550d59de60221c5bc017b2.png[/img]

We are looking forward to seeing you jump into our game and we will continue to share updates like this, not only regarding game features but also some future plans and events related to Death Front. 

We are deeply thankful for all your feedback and love to see all your ideas, feel free to drop them in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/VEXQB9kmRS]Discord Server.
[/url]
See you soon with more updates!

Death Front Team.
